scientific_integrity: A full proof covers all positive integer triple-community censuses and all real nondegenerate ultrametric stem ratios; exact-rational checks cover finite test instances only.
scientific_limitations: Equal-census positive integer abundances of exactly three taxa; rooted ultrametric binary phylogeny and normalized relative-abundance weighted UniFrac; no sampling-model claims. Novelty assessment could miss unindexed equivalences.
title: A sharp census threshold for Bray–Curtis versus weighted UniFrac rank reversals
